# Slop

> A store for open-source apps and games made with AI. Free to download, builds checked before
> they're offered, rated by people who play them.

## Publishing

- [How to publish on Slop](/publishing.md): requirements, store pages, releases, Slop Build
  (GitHub Actions), maker signatures, Slop Pulse player counts (with code for Python, JS, Rust,
  Go, C# and Godot), where to keep saves (SLOP_SAVE_DIR, for sandbox mode), rules for online
  play and mods (copy them into your project's agent instructions), and a step-by-step
  checklist for agents. This one Markdown file is the whole guide; the page at /publish/guide
  shows the same text.

## People

- [Your Slop portfolio](/portfolio.md): how creatives (artists, animators, composers, sound
  designers, writers…) build the portfolio their People page needs: the `.slop/portfolio.json`
  format, every limit Slop checks, ready-made templates, and a checklist for agents.
